notes.title: Visit Carlyle in the ENIGMA: Demo, Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26010749/5a9583f30f18de46d28985e68618f529d6526b2d.png[/img]
We're happy to announce that everyone can now visit the fantastic world of ENIGMA: in a free demo!

Meet the residents of Carlyle and fall in love with the mysterious atmosphere of the island in this new demo which contains [b]the full first route of the game, with 7 endings to unlock[/b]!

The demo covers around 1/3 of the entire game, so there's plenty for everyone to explore. To download it, just head over to the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/494100/ENIGMA/]store page[/url] and click on the "Download Demo" button on the sidebar.

Just remember to stock tissues!

notes.title: ENIGMA: Version 1.3 Released
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26010749/a24332d028f5f4b2b43e4b9b52f0e468c2e16b31.png[/img]
Version 1.3 of [b]ENIGMA:[/b] is now live with a number of improvements.

Changes:
[list][*]Improved the spacing of menu items (requires starting a new game from main menu)[/list]
Fixes:
[list][*]Fixed a bug allowing you to try to load empty save slots
[*]Corrected the text in the background of empty save slots
[*]Fixed a bug that would in some scenes leave graphic artifacts on the left side of the screen if playing in full-screen mode[/list]

notes.title: ENIGMA: Is Here!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26010749/2a97b568cc497eae1cc46bffa950d7cd43ccd3ac.png[/img]
[b]ENIGMA:[/b] is now available on Steam! Struggle with Chester to unravel the mystery of the deadly epidemic before his time runs out in this riveting dark fantasy.

 Is there hope left in the world?

Here is what some early reviewers had to say about ENIGMA:
[list]“A truly rewarding - and at times disturbing - experience that makes every twist, turn and replay of the story well worth it.” 
[b]9.5/10[/b] – [b]Realm of Gaming[/b][/list]
[list]“With a few twist and turns, beautiful soundtrack, and equally charming artwork, it is a title that will captivate you until its end.” 
[b]Moonlitasteria[/b][/list]

notes.title: ENIGMA: First Impressions by Operation Rainfall
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26010749/95250a84375e41367fbfc54af266f3e07fe67d55.png[/img]
Curious to take a peek into the world of [b]ENIGMA:[/b] ahead of the release? Look no further than [url=http://operationrainfall.com/2016/11/07/impressions-enigma/]this preview by [b]Operation Rainfall[/b][/url] into the game!

[i]"So if I was doing a full review, this game would get a very good score. As a preview, it certainly left a great impression and I think they have a really good story on their hands."[/i]

[b]ENIGMA:[/b] will be released on [b]November 15[/b], look forward to it!

notes.title: Special Bonus Unlocked!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26010749/3808f1a9ebde55226b3338b46d514235ad3fd804.png[/img]
We have a special bonus for the players! Every copy of ENIGMA: will include a free Mini Soundtrack with the game's opening and ending songs, as well as a scan of the game cover and a .PDF manual booklet!

The Mini Soundtrack is compatible with Steam Music. You can find the files in a bonus folder in the game's installation folder.

notes.title: ENIGMA: Arriving November 15!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26010749/1e56d97ac62772e79b1114b24bab8717d24ec36f.png[/img]

We are happy to announce that Uzumeya's amospheric, dark fantasy visual novel [b]ENIGMA:[/b] will land on the shores of Steam on [b]November 15[/b]!

Prepare to be swept away by the memorable story and gorgeous artwork! ENIGMA: features almost 20 unique endings that you won't soon forget.

The Steam screenshot section has also been updated with new screenshots, check them out.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/494100
